name: Centum RFQ Memory Module
description: Cognee-backed versioned memory service for RFQ context: ingest RFQ documents, query semantic memory for part history, track citation lineage across versions.

planned_tools.name: centum_rfq_memory__ingest
planned_tools.description: Ingest RFQ-related documents (BOM, quotes, specs) into the versioned semantic memory store.

planned_tools.name: centum_rfq_memory__query
planned_tools.description: Query the semantic memory store for context relevant to a part number or RFQ question.

notes: memory_service.py uses cognee==1.4.2 (PINNED). Do NOT bump to 1.5.x — breaks on Python 3.10/Windows. This module is not a FastMCP server yet; tool names above are planned API surface.
